scripts.setup:install: docker compose run --rm api npm install
scripts.setup:generate: docker compose run --rm api npm run prisma:generate -w @dealflow/api
scripts.setup:bucket: docker compose exec minio mc alias set local http://localhost:9000 minioadmin minioadmin && docker compose exec minio mc mb --ignore-existing local/dealflow
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec -w /repo/apps/api api npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: docker compose exec api npm run prisma:deploy -w @dealflow/api
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose exec -w /repo/apps/api api npx prisma migrate status
scripts.studio: docker compose exec -w /repo/apps/api api npx prisma studio
